general_information.name: OH—MY NAME? I’M GETTING MIXED UP A BIT. DO YOU MEAN THE NAME ON MY PAPERWORK, OR JUST HOW I USUALLY GO BY? I CAN’T QUITE THINK OF THE WHOLE THING RIGHT THIS SECOND.
general_information.family_doctor_name: OH, THE DOCTOR’S NAME—I’M DRAWING A BLANK ON THE EXACT FULL NAME RIGHT NOW. IT’S DR. PARK, I THINK, BUT I’D RATHER NOT GUESS THE FIRST NAME.

current_concerns.primary_problems: Well, lately it’s been a bit hard to sort out. I’ve just been feeling… not quite myself, and things that used to be easier seem to take more out of me. There’s been sleep trouble too, which doesn’t help. I might need you to say that another way?
current_concerns.goals: I’d like to get back to enjoying life, and stay active if I can.

medications.current_medications:
Medication 1: Name Or Description: Carbidopa-levodopa.; Dose: 25/100 mg, one tablet three times daily.; Start Or Duration: I started it in 2024.; Side Effects: Occasionally it makes me feel a bit nauseous.
Medication 2: Name Or Description: Yes, I am—latanoprost eye drops.; Dose: One drop in each eye nightly.; Start Or Duration: 2021.; Side Effects: None known.
Medication 3: Name Or Description: Yes, one more—um, allopurinol.; Dose: 100 mg daily.; Start Or Duration: I started that in 2019.; Side Effects: None known.

family_psychiatric_history.family_psychiatric_history_details: Family member 1: Name Or Description: My granddaughter.; Diagnosis Or Condition: ADHD.; Additional Details: She was diagnosed when she was 9, I think. That’s all I know.

substance_use.alcohol_use: Status: Current; Substance or product: Wine.; Quantity or frequency: Monthly.; Duration: Just minimal, really. I don’t have a long history of it.

education_employment_legal_history.employment_history: Job 1: Name Or Description: Oakville District School Board.; Job Title: High school science teacher.; Dates: 1978 to 2013.

personal_history.early_childhood: I was born and grew up... I’d say just a fairly ordinary childhood, nothing too remarkable.
personal_history.adolescence_early_adulthood: School, mostly. I became a teacher. That’s the main thing I remember clearly.
personal_history.significant_relationships: I’ve been married for 49 years, and my wife has been very supportive.
personal_history.future_goals: I want to enjoy life and manage this illness.
